name: Binding Coil
text:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger Your Strike with the affixed weapon damages a creature

Requirements You're an expert in Athletics.

---
This talisman, a bright red coil that is warm to the touch and faintly resembles a serpent, wraps entirely around your weapon. When you activate this talisman's effect, attempt to grapple the creature you damaged; on a success, one end of the coil wraps itself around the target. This has a Grapple's normal effects, except that the DC to escape dc=20 is 20 and you can move without freeing the creature as long as you don't move further away from it.
